decision_basis: Revenue growth and positive cash after lease servicing preserve recovery upside, but deteriorating margins, inventory-supported cash and dividends above the conservative surplus weaken the income compensation at 17.71x. A weak price trend adds timing risk; the evidence is balanced rather than an established impairment.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager: payout quality is a measured weakness, while positive cash prevents assuming a value-destructive sell thesis.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
